text:
anya.design: Quick microcopy review — the console toast for when a model fails to initialize currently says: 'Model failed to initialize. Learn more.' a11y flagged it as vague and non-actionable. Thoughts?

kai.prod: ugh yeah customers see that a lot. we need something that tells them if a retry will help, and surface the model id so they can file tickets.

leo.eng: from infra side the common failures are incompatible weights or runtime OOM. Sometimes retry helps, often it doesn't. We can detect if a transient error (e.g. network) vs terminal (model format). We could vary messaging.

maria.a11y: accessibility notes: toasts are announced via aria-live. If the toast includes only 'Learn more' link that's not great out of context. Link text should stand alone. Also avoid overly long toasts for screen reader users.

anya.design: proposing a set of variants to choose from:
- Variant 1 (concise, actionable): "Model initialization failed — retry" (with Retry button)
- Variant 2 (explicit, includes id): "Model 'gpt-7b-v0' failed to initialize. Retry or view details."
- Variant 3 (diagnostic): "Model failed to initialize: runtime OOM. See details."
Which direction?

kai.prod: Variant 2 is my pick. Including the model id reduces back-and-forth in support. Make 'view details' go to a small diagnostic panel. Track if Retry fixes it.

leo.eng: Variant 2 ok. Implementation notes: avoid huge toast widths. Retry should call the existing restart endpoint. For diagnostics we can surface a tiny summary: reason + timestamp + correlation id.

maria.a11y: for SR friendliness: use aria-live="assertive" for failure to ensure it's announced immediately. Make the toast role="alert" and ensure interactive controls are keyboard reachable. For the link/button labels: use full phrases, e.g., 'View initialization details for gpt-7b-v0' if it's a standalone link; or keep short buttons but pair with offscreen text.

anya.design: updated microcopy candidate for the UI (visual + SR):
- Visual text: "Model gpt-7b-v0 failed to initialize."
- Primary action (button): "Retry"
- Secondary action (link): "View details" (with aria-describedby to an offscreen summary)
Screen reader accessible name for the toast: "Model gpt-7b-v0 failed to initialize. Retry or view details."

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-22T09:14:12Z: canary-runtime-1 restarted 3/3 workers.

kai.prod: couple of product nits: 1) Add a short hint in details panel about likely next steps (retry, choose lighter quantized variant). 2) If model id is long, show truncated in UI but full in aria-label.

leo.eng: agree on truncation approach. Also suggest we only surface exact failure type in details panel; toast should stay simple.

maria.a11y: final checklist: role=alert, aria-live=assertive, buttons tabbable, link text meaningful, truncated visuals have full aria-label. Also test with screen readers to confirm concise announcement.

anya.design: thanks! I'll update the figma component and put the copy in the component token. Will push a tiny PR for snack CSS + aria attributes. Posting mock shortly. :white_check_mark:
